Basic Information.Supported CPU:
AMD Socket AM5, support for:
AMD Ryzen 9000 Series Processors
AMD Ryzen 8000 Series Processors
AMD Ryzen 7000 Series Processors
Basic Information.BIOS:
1 x 256 Mbit flash
Use of licensed AMI UEFI BIOS
PnP 1.0a, DMI 2.7, WfM 2.0, SM BIOS 2.7, ACPI 5.0

Memory.Maximum Memory: Up to 256 GB (64 GB single DIMM capacity) of system memory

Graphics.Graphics:
Integrated Graphics Processor with AMD Radeon™ Graphics support:
- 1 x DisplayPort, supporting a maximum resolution of 3840x2160@144 Hz
* Support for DisplayPort 1.4 version and HDR.
- 1 x Front HDMI port, supporting a maximum resolution of 1920x1080@30 Hz

Connector & Ports.LAN Port (s): Realtek® 2.5GbE LAN chip (2.5 Gbps/1 Gbps/100 Mbps)
Connector & Ports.RAID: RAID 0, RAID 1, RAID 5, and RAID 10 support for NVMe SSD storage devices
Connector & Ports.TPM (Trusted Platform Module ): 1 x Trusted Platform Module header (For the GC-TPM2.0 SPI/GC-TPM2.0 SPI 2.0/GC-TPM2.0 SPI V2 module only)
Connector & Ports.Wireless Communication module:
Realtek® Wi-Fi 7 RTL8922AE
- 802.11a, b, g, n, ac, ax, be, supporting 2.4/5/6 GHz carrier frequency bands
- BLUETOOTH 5.4
- Support for 11be 160MHz wireless standard(Actual data rate may vary depending on environment and equipment.)

Others.Special Features:
Support for GIGABYTE Control Center (GCC)
* Available applications in GCC may vary by motherboard model. Supported functions of each application may also vary depending on motherboard specifications.
Support for Q-Flash
Support for Q-Flash Plus
Support for Smart Backup
Others.Bundled Software:
Norton® Internet Security (OEM version)
LAN bandwidth management software
